crossRefs.note: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.
The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
You are righteous, Yahweh, when I contend with you; yet I would like to reason the cause with you. Why does the way of…
May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be…
May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in…
But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath?…
All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of…
All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of…
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

translations.web: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
translations.bsb: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
